sections.description: Embeds Agend app surfaces (LMS, Loop) in an iframe with host-assisted single sign-on. When the embed reports it has no session, this plugin navigates the iframe through the site's own IdP-initiated SSO so a logged-in member is signed into the embed without re-entering credentials. Works with any WordPress SAML IdP via a driver filter.
sections.changelog:
• feat: self-hosted plugin updates from per-plugin GitHub Releases (9d9b208)
  • feat: agend-embed plugin - host-assisted embed SSO, IdP-agnostic (0ca8391)
